descriptionMarkdown: Sity block v2 - book containing a new design of sity blocks. Unlike common throughout the internet 100x100 city block designs, this 100x200+100x100 design is bigger, does not have any entities like power poles and roboports in the middle (so tired of that kind of crap), and has a built-in rail system intended for 1+8+1 trains. The disadvantage is that it does not contain roads for vehicles like cars and tanks, but honestly, I've never used it cuz playing through the map.
title: Sity block v2
